prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent game sprite atlas for School Life RPG, classroom furniture expansion.
Create exactly 16 original isolated sprites in strict 4-column by 4-row equal-size grid. Square canvas. Each sprite contained entirely in central 75% of its own cell, ample fully transparent margins at outer edges and between sprites. No labels, no border, no drawn checkerboard. True alpha background.
STYLE: cheerful cozy top-down 2D RPG pixel art, warm honey wood, teal painted metal, cream, coral accents, green chalkboards. Crisp deliberately simple square pixel clusters, visually designed at 32x32 logical resolution per prop then nearest-neighbor enlarged. No gradients, no thin microdetail, no soft airbrush, no bloom, no photorealism. Consistent limited palette and 1 logical pixel dark brown outline. Same fixed orthographic elevated RPG camera, front and top visible, vertical sides, horizontal fronts; NOT isometric. Light upper left. Objects are stationary game props, consistent design language.
Strict row-major contents:
row 1: single student desk with closed blue book; double student desk with two drawers; simple teal student chair; teacher desk with notebook and pencil cup.
row 2: green chalkboard on wooden frame with a few abstract chalk marks; clean whiteboard on small stand; cork bulletin board with colorful blank paper notes; tall classroom bookcase with colorful books.
row 3: low open book shelf; ceiling-mounted classroom projector; round wall clock with plain face; ceiling fan seen from above.
row 4: wall air conditioner; classroom trash bin; two-pane classroom window with cream curtains; wooden classroom door with small glass panel.
Every object complete and separate. No people, no room background, no floor plane, no writing except simple clock tick marks. Fit each whole object inside its cell with space on all sides. No borrowed existing sprites. Produce a practical sprite sheet, not a poster or scene.

Create ONE transparent 4 by 4 evenly spaced sprite atlas with exactly 16 isolated school functional-room props. Original cheerful cozy pixel-art RPG style. Warm honey wood, teal, cream, coral, green, vivid but harmonious palette. Dark brown pixel outlines. Fixed orthographic elevated top-down RPG view, horizontal fronts, NOT isometric. Simple chunky square pixel clusters, no smooth shading, no tiny texture details. Every complete object fits central 70% of its equal cell. Clear generous transparent gutters; transparent alpha background, no background scenery, no floor, no labels, no text, no grid lines. Each sprite separate, not a scene. Strict row-major order:
Row1 LIBRARY: large double bookshelf filled with colorful books; wooden reading table with open book; upholstered teal reading armchair; library lookup desktop computer on small pedestal desk.
Row2 SCIENCE: white laboratory bench with sink; microscope; rack containing four colorful test tubes; colorful atom teaching model.
Row3 ART: wooden easel with simple flower painting; oval artist paint palette with brush; white plaster classical bust on small pedestal; pottery wheel with clay pot.
Row4 GYM: freestanding basketball hoop; wooden three-tier bleachers; rolled teal exercise mat; badminton racket paired with shuttlecock.
Make a consistent coherent sprite sheet for a cute school life game. All objects fully inside cells with margin. Square output.

Create ONE square transparent PNG sprite atlas, exactly 16 isolated cozy school game objects in a strict evenly spaced 4 columns by 4 rows grid. Original pixel art with chunky simple pixels, warm honey wood and teal metal, cream and coral highlights, brown pixel outlines. Same elevated orthographic top-down RPG camera showing fronts and tops, horizontal front edges, NOT isometric. No scenery. All objects fully visible, centered within central 70% of equal cells with wide clear transparent gutters. True alpha, no drawn checkerboard, no text, no labels, no grid. Consistent cheerful school life visual style.
Strict row-major order:
row1: long cafeteria dining table; single cafeteria chair; school cafeteria serving counter with three food trays; compact cream refrigerator with teal handles.
row2: cream microwave oven; teal drink vending machine with colorful drink buttons and cans, no lettering; three connected teal school lockers; honey wood hallway bench.
row3: wall-mounted hand washing sink; freestanding water dispenser with blue bottle; compartment lunch tray with rice vegetables and egg; bowl of Vietnamese pho noodles with herbs and chopsticks.
row4: Vietnamese banh mi baguette with vegetables; triangular sandwich; milk carton next to juice box, blank packaging; wicker basket with apple banana and orange.
Only 16 objects/groups, one per cell, entire silhouettes fit inside cells, no cross-cell elements, no cast shadows outside each sprite. Pixel-art game asset sheet, not a poster.

Create ONE square transparent PNG sprite atlas with exactly 16 separate school outdoor assets, strict 4 columns by 4 rows evenly spaced equal cells. Original cozy cheerful 2D RPG pixel art, warm honey wood, cream masonry, teal painted metal, coral accents, bright green foliage, dark brown outlines. Orthographic elevated top-down RPG view with horizontal front edges, not diamond isometric. Simple crisp square pixel clusters. True transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no text or labels, no grid. Every object complete within central 70% of its cell with wide transparent margins, absolutely no overlaps or cutoffs. Each item is standalone scenery except the two terrain sample patches.
Strict row-major arrangement:
row1: school entry gate with cream stone pillars and teal gate; simple flagpole with plain coral flag; rectangular flower bed with yellow pink flowers; rounded leafy shade tree.
row2: stone school bench; small square beige paved path patch; small square green grass patch; miniature rectangular school soccer field with white lines and two goals.
row3: playground swing set with teal support and two seats; cheerful coral-and-teal slide; wooden seesaw with teal supports; small teal climbing frame.
row4: square wooden sandbox with bucket; teal city bicycle; compact cream and coral motor scooter; small cream school shuttle minibus with teal windows, no lettering.
Each whole object fits its own cell. Fronts face viewer, elevated tops visible. No characters, no scene connecting the cells, no external shadows. All 16 items clearly recognizable and stylistically consistent.
